SQL:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    COUNT(*) AS "orders.n",
    COUNT(orders.amount) AS "orders.na",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.sa"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  WHERE
    NOT orders.customer_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name
), _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    SUM(orders.amount - customers.discount) AS "orders.net"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  WHERE
    NOT orders.customer_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name
), _cm_orders__customers__discount_count AS (
  SELECT
    regions.name AS "customers.regions.name",
    COUNT(customers.discount) AS "customers.discount_count"
  FROM customers AS customers
  LEFT JOIN regions AS regions
    ON customers.region_id = regions.id
  WHERE
    EXISTS(
      SELECT
        1
      FROM orders AS orders
      WHERE
        customers.id = orders.customer_id AND NOT orders.customer_id IS NULL
    )
  GROUP BY
    regions.name
), _cm_orders__customers__id_count AS (
  SELECT
    regions.name AS "customers.regions.name",
    COUNT(customers.id) AS "customers.id_count"
  FROM customers AS customers
  LEFT JOIN regions AS regions
    ON customers.region_id = regions.id
  WHERE
    EXISTS(
      SELECT
        1
      FROM orders AS orders
      WHERE
        customers.id = orders.customer_id AND NOT orders.customer_id IS NULL
    )
  GROUP BY
    regions.name
), _cm_orders__customers__discount_sum AS (
  SELECT
    regions.name AS "customers.regions.name",
    CAST(SUM(customers.discount) AS DOUBLE) AS "customers.discount_sum"
  FROM customers AS customers
  LEFT JOIN regions AS regions
    ON customers.region_id = regions.id
  WHERE
    EXISTS(
      SELECT
        1
      FROM orders AS orders
      WHERE
        customers.id = orders.customer_id AND NOT orders.customer_id IS NULL
    )
  GROUP BY
    regions.name
)
SELECT
  _base."orders.customers.regions.name",
  _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum."orders.net",
  _base."orders.n",
  _base."orders.na",
  COALESCE(_cm_orders__customers__discount_count."customers.discount_count", 0) AS "orders.nd",
  COALESCE(_cm_orders__customers__id_count."customers.id_count", 0) AS "orders.nc",
  _base."orders.sa",
  _cm_orders__customers__discount_sum."customers.discount_sum" AS "orders.sd"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum
  ON _base."orders.customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum."orders.customers.regions.name"
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__customers__discount_count
  ON _base."orders.customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__customers__discount_count."customers.regions.name"
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__customers__id_count
  ON _base."orders.customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__customers__id_count."customers.regions.name"
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__customers__discount_sum
  ON _base."orders.customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__customers__discount_sum."customers.regions.name"
LIMIT 21

args.message: Here is the total of order amount minus the customer's discount for each region. Each order's region comes from its customer's region. I left out orders that have no customer.
